svg.title: Quorum and safe failover
svg.desc: Teaching example • three voting database nodes. 1 Network partition A is the old leader and becomes isolated B and C can still communicate 2 Majority side: B + C Two of three votes establish a majority Elect an eligible, sufficiently current leader 3 Preserve committed history Voting, term and log rules enforce authority Resume under valid commit and read rules 4 Minority side: A alone One of three votes cannot establish authority No authoritative commits or unsafe reads. Cards 2–3 describe the majority; card 4 the minority. A partition is not necessarily a crashed server.

g.text: Teaching example • three voting database nodes
A is the old leader and becomes isolated
B and C can still communicate
Two of three votes establish a majority
Elect an eligible, sufficiently current leader
Voting, term and log rules enforce authority
Resume under valid commit and read rules
One of three votes cannot establish authority
No authoritative commits or unsafe reads
Cards 2–3 describe the majority; card 4 the minority.
A partition is not necessarily a crashed server.
